results.why: C+ emits the named [CPLUS-SAFE-LIFETIME] use-after-free diagnostic at compile time. Rust has no safe spelling for this operation: the equivalent needs `unsafe` raw pointers and is undefined behaviour with no guaranteed deterministic trap (observed here: rustc accepts and the binary ran to completion). This is an intentional difference in enforcement point, not an agreement.
